WITH daily AS (
  -- sales by sale date, all real sales locations (stores and web shop), training store 999 excluded
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS amount
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  -- refunds deducted on the return date
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id <> 999
),
weekly AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, sum(x.amount) AS net_sales
  FROM daily x JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = x.business_date
  GROUP BY ALL
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date
  FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period = 2
)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_period, w.fiscal_week, w.fiscal_week_start_date AS week_start_date,
       round(c.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales,
       ly.fiscal_year AS prior_year_fiscal_year, ly.fiscal_week AS prior_year_fiscal_week, ly.fiscal_week_start_date AS prior_year_week_start_date,
       round(ly.net_sales, 2) AS prior_year_net_sales,
       round(100.0 * (c.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS growth_pct
FROM weeks w
JOIN weekly c ON c.fiscal_year = w.fiscal_year AND c.fiscal_week = w.fiscal_week
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week_start_date = w.fiscal_week_start_date - INTERVAL 364 DAY
ORDER BY w.fiscal_week

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS amount FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key WHERE s.store_id <> 999
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, round(sum(x.amount),2) net_sales
FROM daily x JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = x.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 5 AND 9 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2
